native_tui_vs_pristine.note: Both runs use cargo test on the same 0.155.1 tree. Every failure is a release-tag snapshot (the snapshot header reads v0.0.0 while the built crate reports v0.155.1) or a terminal-probe test that only fails under parallel execution; the five tests whose outcome differed between parallel runs fail identically on both trees when run alone, and the guard's own 28 cases pass.

baseline_limitations: Host restrictions prevent creating user namespaces for several stock sandbox integration fixtures.
The official source tag has release-version snapshot mismatches. Those snapshots were not rewritten to claim a green suite.

package_python.tests: State, check, reasoning, sessions/prune, installer, launcher and updater units; official app-server SSE/WebSocket fixtures including body-label mismatch and header precedence; real PTY new/resume/fork/Fish cx resume/paste/resize; a disclosed route difference and a body-label difference each interrupt the turn, hold the next prompt and a /compact and are explained in /status; a thread restored on gpt-reserve stops before its first turn; stock terminal-mode and scrollback parity.

review.scope: Stop semantics of 1.10.0. Ten findings (compaction and review targets enqueued around the composer, Codex's usage recovery lifting a stop, guard state lost across widget rebuilds, a running turn restored under a stop, background threads never judged, enforcement suspended after an account change, a global review-model exemption, server-pushed settings, model-bearing collaboration presets, unsanitized history text) were fixed and covered by regression tests, except the model-bearing preset case, which is documented as a stop the user clears with /model.
